annotations.title: Trip readiness brief: visa + over-stay check + US/UK advisories + holidays + FX + checklist

description: Use before booking or confirming an international trip for a traveller: one call returns the visa rule for passport -> destination with an over-stay check against the dates, the US State Department level and UK FCDO alerts, public holidays inside the dates, the live exchange rate, Schengen specifics (90/180, EES, ETIAS status, passport-validity rule), a passport-validity check and a checklist with official links. Optional: passport, destination, depart, return (YYYY-MM-DD), home_currency, passport_expiry. PAID: $0.150 per call, no API key or account, or free with a Trip Desk Pass. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/trip-brief.

depart.description: Arrival date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days from today

home_currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the FX line. Default: the passport country's currency

pass.description: Optional Trip Desk Pass token (tp1....). With a valid pass this call is not charged. Prefer setting it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

passport.description: Traveller nationality: ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 or English name. Default (bare call): US

passport_expiry.description: Optional passport expiry date YYYY-MM-DD for the validity check

return.description: Departure date from the destination YYYY-MM-DD. Default: depart + 7 days
